title: Elf Bar Elfa Pro Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The ELFA Pro Pod Kit from Elf Bar is the next evolution of the bestselling Elfa Prefilled Disposable Pod Kit and your new go-to for an exceptionally satisfying and simple vaping experience. Compact yet powerful, this sleek vape pen houses a long-lasting, rechargeable battery so you can vape all day long without worrying about finding the next charging point. The Elfa Pro Pod kit is available in a variety of striking colours to suit your personal style, with a prefilled Elfa Pro pod flavour included with each colour: • Dark Gold: Pineapple Ice • Aurora Blue: Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava • Aurora Purple: Watermelon • Aurora Green: Apple Peach • Aurora Pink: Pink Lemonade • Black: Blue Razz Lemonade • Navy Blue: Blueberry Sour Raspberry • Twilight Blue: Mixed Berries • Twilight Brown: Cola • Twilight Green: Lemon & Lime • Twilight Cyan: Spearmint • Twilight Purple: Mad Blue Designed specifically with MTL (Mouth to Lung) vapers in mind, the ELFA Pro Pod Kit features inhale-activated technology, making it as simple as it is satisfying to use. No buttons to press, no settings to adjust and no coils to swap. Plus, the pods are easy to see through, so you'll never have to guess when it's time for a pod change. One of the standout features of this pod kit is its compatibility with the ELFA Pro Pods. Prefilled with 2ml of e-liquid and 20mg of nicotine salt e-liquid, these pods offer a diverse range of delicious flavours for you to try. And the best part? They're quick and easy to change, making it simple to switch up your vaping experience whenever you fancy something new. But it's not just the variety of flavours that makes these pods special. Thanks to the integrated QUAQ mesh coil technology, you can expect even faster heat-up times and more efficient e-liquid vaporisation. This means more flavour with every puff. Did You Know? As members of the diverse Elf Bar family of prefilled pod kits, Elfa Pods, Elfa Pro Pods are completely interchangeable . This means that whichever Elf Bar Prefilled Pod Kit you own, any of these pre-filled pods will be compatible with your device, putting a wealth of delicious flavours from across the Elf Bar collections at your fingertips. Please note: The Elfa Pro Pod Kit is sold without a USB-C Cable. A USB-C cable can be purchased separately. In order to activate your new Elfa Pro prefilled pod, first remove the stickers from the base and the side and remove the silicon plug in the mouthpiece, then gently press the base of the pod upwards. This allows the e-liquid to flow into the chamber and come into contact with the coil. Then simply insert the Elfa Pro Pod into the battery component. We recommend allowing the activated pod to sit for approx. 5 minutes to avoid any dry or burnt hits. See our video below for help .
